# 1. Load and clean INDEPTH mortality microdata

```{r load-health}


wa_prefixes <- c("BF", "CI", "GH", "GM", "NG", "SN")

west_africa_mortality <- raw_data %>%
  filter(str_sub(centreid, 1, 2) %in% wa_prefixes) %>%
  filter(eventcode == 7) %>%   # confirmed deaths
  filter(residence == 1)       # resident at site on day of death

processed_cases <- west_africa_mortality %>%
  mutate(
    eventdate = as.Date(eventdate),
    dob       = as.Date(dob),
    age_at_death = as.numeric(difftime(eventdate, dob, units = "days")) / 365.25,
    year  = year(eventdate),
    month = month(eventdate),
    dow   = wday(eventdate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    stratum_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  select(countryid, stratum_id, concat_individualid, centreid, locationid,
         sex, age_at_death, eventdate, year, month, dow) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_at_death <= 5                          ~ "Young Children (<=5)",
      age_at_death > 5  & age_at_death <= 18      ~ "School-age (5-18)",
      age_at_death > 18 & age_at_death <= 65       ~ "Working-age (18-65)",
      age_at_death > 65                            ~ "Elderly (>65)",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c(
      "Young Children (<=5)", "School-age (5-18)",
      "Working-age (18-65)", "Elderly (>65)"
    )),
    country_name = case_when(
      countryid == 854 ~ "Burkina Faso",
      countryid == 288 ~ "Ghana",
      countryid == 384 ~ "Côte d'Ivoire",
      countryid == 270 ~ "The Gambia",
      countryid == 566 ~ "Nigeria",
      countryid == 686 ~ "Senegal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    # Correction: Nanoro (BF021) is mis-tabulated under Ethiopia's countryid
    # in this extract; centreid prefix is the reliable source of truth.
    country_name = if_else(str_sub(centreid, 1, 2) == "BF", "Burkina Faso", country_name)
  )

processed_cases %>% count(country_name, countryid)
```

# 2. Time-stratified case-crossover matrix (Bateson & Schwartz design)

Referents are all other days in the same calendar month falling on the same
day of week as the death -- this design inherently controls for long-term
trend, season, and day-of-week without needing separate spline terms for
those factors.

```{r case-crossover}
get_referent_days <- function(case_date) {
  m_start <- floor_date(case_date, "month")
  m_end   <- ceiling_date(case_date, "month") - days(1)
  month_days <- seq(m_start, m_end, by = "1 day")
  month_days[wday(month_days) == wday(case_date) & month_days != case_date]
}

cc_matrix <- processed_cases %>%
  group_by(stratum_id) %>%
  do({
    case_row <- .
    control_dates <- get_referent_days(case_row$eventdate)
    control_rows <- map_df(control_dates, ~ case_row %>% mutate(eventdate = .x, outcome = 0))
    case_row <- case_row %>% mutate(outcome = 1)
    bind_rows(case_row, control_rows)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

final_health_data <- cc_matrix %>%
  rename(date = eventdate) %>%
  mutate(time_in_study = as.numeric(date) - min(as.numeric(date))) %>%
  arrange(stratum_id, date) %>%
  filter(year >= 2009 & year <= 2016) %>%
  mutate(
    is_tier1 = if_else(year >= 2011 & year <= 2014, 1, 0),
    is_tier2 = if_else(year >= 2009 & year <= 2015 &
                          str_sub(centreid, 1, 2) %in% c("GM", "CI", "SN", "BF"), 1, 0)
  )

write_csv(final_health_data, "final_health.csv")
```

# 3. Load and process UTCI climate data, build lag matrix
```{r}
UTCI_daily <- read_csv(PATH_UTCI)
names(UTCI_daily)
```


```{r climate}
UTCI_daily <- UTCI_daily %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    across(c(utci_min, utci_mean, utci_max), ~ . - 273.15)
  ) %>%
  rename(centreid = site_id) %>%
  arrange(centreid, date) %>%
  group_by(centreid) %>%
  mutate(
    utci_lag0 = utci_mean
  )

for(i in 1:MAX_LAG){

    UTCI_daily <-
        UTCI_daily %>%
        mutate(
            !!paste0("utci_lag",i) :=
                lag(utci_mean,i)
        )

}

UTCI_daily <- UTCI_daily %>%
    ungroup()
```

```{r climate-trend-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
for (current_site in unique(UTCI_daily$centreid)) {
  site_data <- UTCI_daily %>%
    filter(centreid == current_site) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(utci_min, utci_mean, utci_max),
                 names_to = "index_type", values_to = "utci_value") %>%
    mutate(index_type = recode(index_type,
      utci_max = "Maximum UTCI", utci_mean = "Mean UTCI", utci_min = "Minimum UTCI"))

  p <- ggplot(site_data, aes(date, utci_value, color = index_type)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Maximum UTCI" = "#d95f02",
                                   "Mean UTCI" = "#7570b3",
                                   "Minimum UTCI" = "#1b9e77")) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "2 years") +
    labs(title = paste("UTCI Trends:", current_site),
         x = "Year", y = "UTCI (\u00b0C)", color = "Metric") +
    theme_ipsum(grid = "XY") + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p)
}
```

# 4. Merge exposure onto the case-crossover matrix

```{r merge}
analysis_ready_matrix <- final_health_data %>%
  left_join(UTCI_daily, by = c("centreid", "date"))

stopifnot(nrow(analysis_ready_matrix) == nrow(final_health_data))
n_missing_exposure <- sum(is.na(analysis_ready_matrix$utci_mean))
message(n_missing_exposure, " rows failed to match a UTCI grid cell (dropped below).")

analysis_ready_matrix <-analysis_ready_matrix %>%filter(
  !is.na(
    .data[[paste0("utci_lag",MAX_LAG)]]))
```

```{r}
library(dlnm)
library(gnm)
library(corrplot)

library(dlnm)
library(gnm)
library(dplyr)

compare_lag_windows <- function(
    data,
    outcome_var = "outcome",
    exposure_var = "utci_mean",
    stratum_var = "stratum_id",
    lag_prefix = "utci_lag",
    lag_windows = c(3,7,14,21,28),
    exposure_df = 3,
    prediction_by = 0.1
){

  ##########################################################
  # Exposure basis fixed across all models
  ##########################################################

  var_knots <- equalknots(
    data[[exposure_var]],
    fun = "ns",
    df = exposure_df
  )

  ##########################################################
  # Helper for lag basis
  ##########################################################

  get_lag_basis <- function(max_lag){

    if(max_lag <= 3){

      list(fun = "integer")

    } else if(max_lag <= 7){

      list(fun = "ns", df = 2)

    } else if(max_lag <= 14){

      list(fun = "ns", df = 3)

    } else {

      list(
        fun = "ns",
        knots = logknots(max_lag, nk = 3)
      )

    }

  }

  ##########################################################
  # Storage
  ##########################################################

  results <- list()

  ##########################################################
  # Loop through lag windows
  ##########################################################

  for(max_lag in lag_windows){

    cat("\n")
    cat("====================================\n")
    cat("Fitting lag window:", max_lag, "\n")
    cat("====================================\n")

    lag_cols <- paste0(
      lag_prefix,
      0:max_lag
    )

    ########################################################
    # Check lag variables exist
    ########################################################

    missing_cols <- setdiff(
      lag_cols,
      names(data)
    )

    if(length(missing_cols) > 0){

      warning(
        paste(
          "Missing columns:",
          paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
        )
      )

      next

    }

    ########################################################
    # Build lag matrix
    ########################################################

    lag_matrix <- as.matrix(
      data[, lag_cols]
    )

    ########################################################
    # Complete cases
    ########################################################

    keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)

    analysis_data <- data[keep, ]

    lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep, ]

    cat(
      "Rows retained:",
      nrow(analysis_data),
      "\n"
    )

    ########################################################
    # Crossbasis
    ########################################################

    cb <- crossbasis(
      lag_matrix,
      lag = max_lag,
      argvar = list(
        fun = "ns",
        knots = var_knots
      ),
      arglag = get_lag_basis(max_lag)
    )

    ########################################################
    # Diagnostics
    ########################################################

    rank_cb <- qr(cb)$rank

    n_basis <- ncol(cb)

    kappa_val <- tryCatch(
      kappa(cb),
      error = function(e) NA
    )

    max_cor <- tryCatch({

      R <- cor(cb)

      max(
        abs(R[upper.tri(R)]),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

    },
    error = function(e) NA)

    ########################################################
    # Fit model
    ########################################################

    formula_fit <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome_var,
        " ~ cb"
      )
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(

      gnm(
        formula_fit,
        eliminate = factor(
          analysis_data[[stratum_var]]
        ),
        family = quasipoisson(),
        data = analysis_data
      ),

      error = function(e){

        message(
          "Model failed at lag ",
          max_lag
        )

        return(NULL)

      }

    )

    if(is.null(fit)) next

    ########################################################
    # Overdispersion
    ########################################################

    phi <- tryCatch(
      deviance(fit) /
        df.residual(fit),
      error = function(e) NA
    )

    ########################################################
    # Prediction
    ########################################################

    pred <- tryCatch(

      crosspred(
        cb,
        fit,
        by = prediction_by,
        model.link = "log"
      ),

      error = function(e){

        message(
          "crosspred failed at lag ",
          max_lag
        )

        return(NULL)

      }

    )

    ########################################################
    # MMT
    ########################################################

    MMT <- NA

    if(!is.null(pred)){

      q <- quantile(
        analysis_data[[exposure_var]],
        probs = c(.01,.99),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      idx <- pred$predvar >= q[1] &
        pred$predvar <= q[2]

      if(any(idx)){

        MMT <- pred$predvar[idx][
          which.min(
            pred$allRRfit[idx]
          )
        ]

      }

    }

    ########################################################
    # QAIC
    ########################################################

    p <- length(coef(fit))

    QAIC <- tryCatch(

      deviance(fit) +
        2 * p * phi,

      error = function(e) NA

    )

    ########################################################
    # Store
    ########################################################

    results[[paste0("lag_", max_lag)]] <- list(

      lag_window = max_lag,

      fit = fit,

      pred = pred,

      crossbasis = cb,

      converged = fit$converged,

      phi = phi,

      QAIC = QAIC,

      MMT = MMT,

      rank = rank_cb,

      n_basis = n_basis,

      kappa = kappa_val,

      max_correlation = max_cor

    )

  }

  ##########################################################
  # Summary table
  ##########################################################

  summary_table <- bind_rows(

    lapply(
      results,
      function(x){

        data.frame(

          lag_window = x$lag_window,

          converged = x$converged,

          QAIC = round(x$QAIC,2),

          phi = round(x$phi,2),

          MMT = round(x$MMT,2),

          rank = x$rank,

          n_basis = x$n_basis,

          kappa = round(x$kappa,2),

          max_correlation = round(
            x$max_correlation,
            3
          )

        )

      }

    )

  )

  if(nrow(summary_table) > 0){

    summary_table <-
      summary_table %>%
      arrange(QAIC)

  }

  return(

    list(

      summary = summary_table,

      models = results

    )

  )

}
```

```{r}
plot_lag_comparison <- function(
    lag_compare,
    exposure_var = "UTCI"
){

    ####################################################
    # Extract successful predictions
    ####################################################

    valid_models <- lag_compare$models[
        sapply(
            lag_compare$models,
            function(x) !is.null(x$pred)
        )
    ]

    if(length(valid_models) == 0){

        stop("No valid predictions found.")

    }

    ####################################################
    # Dynamic axis limits
    ####################################################

    x_range <- range(
        unlist(
            lapply(
                valid_models,
                function(x) x$pred$predvar
            )
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
    )

    y_range <- range(
        unlist(
            lapply(
                valid_models,
                function(x) x$pred$allRRfit
            )
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
    )

    ####################################################
    # Colors
    ####################################################

    cols <- c(
        "#1B9E77",
        "#D95F02",
        "#7570B3",
        "#E7298A",
        "#66A61E",
        "#E6AB02",
        "#A6761D"
    )

    ####################################################
    # Empty plot
    ####################################################

    plot(
        NULL,
        xlim = x_range,
        ylim = y_range,
        xlab = exposure_var,
        ylab = "Cumulative Relative Risk",
        main = "DLNM Lag Window Comparison"
    )

    ####################################################
    # Add curves
    ####################################################

    i <- 1

    legend_text <- c()

    for(model_name in names(valid_models)){

        pred <- valid_models[[model_name]]$pred

        lag_window <- valid_models[[model_name]]$lag_window

        MMT <- round(
            valid_models[[model_name]]$MMT,
            1
        )

        lines(
            pred$predvar,
            pred$allRRfit,
            col = cols[i],
            lwd = 2
        )

        abline(
            v = MMT,
            col = cols[i],
            lty = 2
        )

        legend_text <- c(
            legend_text,
            paste0(
                lag_window,
                " d (MMT=",
                MMT,
                ")"
            )
        )

        i <- i + 1

    }

    ####################################################
    # RR=1 reference
    ####################################################

    abline(
        h = 1,
        lty = 2,
        col = "grey40"
    )

    ####################################################
    # Legend
    ####################################################

    legend(
        "topright",
        legend = legend_text,
        col = cols[seq_along(legend_text)],
        lwd = 2,
        bty = "n",
        cex = 0.9
    )

}
```

```{r}
library(dlnm)
library(gnm)
library(dplyr)

dlnm_sensitivity <- function(
    data,
    max_lag = 21,
    exposure_var = "utci_mean",
    outcome_var = "outcome",
    stratum_var = "stratum_id",
    lag_prefix = "utci_lag",
    exposure_dfs = c(3,4,5),
    lag_dfs = c(2,3,4,5),
    by = 0.1
){

    lag_cols <- paste0(
        lag_prefix,
        0:max_lag
    )

    lag_matrix <- as.matrix(
        data[, lag_cols]
    )

    keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)

    lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep, ]

    analysis_data <- data[keep, ]

    results <- list()

    counter <- 1

    for(vdf in exposure_dfs){

        for(ldf in lag_dfs){

            cat(
                "\n",
                "Exposure df =", vdf,
                "| Lag df =", ldf,
                "\n"
            )

            ##################################################
            # Exposure basis
            ##################################################

            var_knots <- equalknots(
                analysis_data[[exposure_var]],
                fun = "ns",
                df = vdf
            )

            ##################################################
            # Lag basis
            ##################################################

            lag_knots <- logknots(
                max_lag,
                nk = ldf
            )

            ##################################################
            # Crossbasis
            ##################################################

            cb <- crossbasis(
                lag_matrix,
                lag = max_lag,
                argvar = list(
                    fun = "ns",
                    knots = var_knots
                ),
                arglag = list(
                    fun = "ns",
                    knots = lag_knots
                )
            )

            ##################################################
            # Fit model
            ##################################################

            fit <- tryCatch(

                gnm(
                    as.formula(
                        paste0(
                            outcome_var,
                            "~ cb"
                        )
                    ),
                    eliminate =
                        factor(
                            analysis_data[[stratum_var]]
                        ),
                    family = quasipoisson(),
                    data = analysis_data
                ),

                error = function(e) NULL
            )

            if(is.null(fit))
                next

            ##################################################
            # Prediction
            ##################################################

            pred <- tryCatch(

                crosspred(
                    cb,
                    fit,
                    by = by,
                    model.link = "log"
                ),

                error = function(e) NULL
            )

            ##################################################
            # MMT
            ##################################################

            MMT <- NA

            if(!is.null(pred)){

                q <- quantile(
                    analysis_data[[exposure_var]],
                    c(.01,.99),
                    na.rm = TRUE
                )

                idx <- pred$predvar >= q[1] &
                    pred$predvar <= q[2]

                MMT <- pred$predvar[idx][
                    which.min(
                        pred$allRRfit[idx]
                    )
                ]

            }

            ##################################################
            # QAIC
            ##################################################

            phi <- deviance(fit) /
                df.residual(fit)

            p <- length(coef(fit))

            QAIC <- deviance(fit) +
                2 * p * phi

            ##################################################
            # Collinearity
            ##################################################

            kappa_val <- tryCatch(
                kappa(cb),
                error=function(e) NA
            )

            ##################################################
            # Save
            ##################################################

            results[[counter]] <- data.frame(

                exposure_df = vdf,

                lag_df = ldf,

                QAIC = QAIC,

                phi = phi,

                MMT = MMT,

                kappa = kappa_val,

                converged =
                    fit$converged

            )

            counter <- counter + 1

        }

    }

    bind_rows(results) %>%
        arrange(QAIC)

}
```



```{r}
spec_results <- dlnm_sensitivity(
    data = analysis_ready_matrix,
    max_lag = 21,
    exposure_dfs = c(3,4,5),
    lag_dfs = c(2,3,4,5)
)

spec_results
```

## You already fitted the models. Now visually compare the best candidates:

```{r}
best_specs <- list(

  "df5_lag5" = list(vdf = 5, ldf = 5),
  "df5_lag4" = list(vdf = 5, ldf = 4),

  "df4_lag5" = list(vdf = 4, ldf = 5)

)

plot(
  NULL,
  xlim = range(analysis_ready_matrix$utci_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  ylim = c(0.8, 2),
  xlab = "UTCI (°C)",

  main = "Sensitivity to Spline Specification"
)

cols <- c(
  "red",
  "blue",
  "darkgreen",
  "purple"
)

i <- 1

for(spec in names(best_specs)){

  vdf <- best_specs[[spec]]$vdf
  ldf <- best_specs[[spec]]$ldf

  var_knots <- equalknots(
    analysis_ready_matrix$utci_mean,
    fun = "ns",
    df = vdf
  )

  lag_knots <- logknots(
    21,
    nk = ldf
  )

  lag_matrix <- as.matrix(
    analysis_ready_matrix[
      ,
      paste0("utci_lag",0:21)
    ]
  )

  keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)

  lag_matrix2 <- lag_matrix[keep,]

  dat <- analysis_ready_matrix[keep,]

  cb <- crossbasis(
    lag_matrix2,
    lag = 21,
    argvar = list(
      fun = "ns",
      knots = var_knots
    ),
    arglag = list(
      fun = "ns",
      knots = lag_knots
    )
  )

  fit <- gnm(
    outcome ~ cb,
    eliminate = factor(stratum_id),
    family = quasipoisson(),
    data = dat
  )

  pred <- crosspred(
    cb,
    fit,
    by = 0.1
  )

  lines(
    pred$predvar,
    pred$allRRfit,
    col = cols[i],
    lwd = 2
  )

  i <- i + 1
}

abline(h = 1, lty = 2)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = names(best_specs),
  col = cols,
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)

```



## 2. MMT Stability Analysis

## This is one of the most important checks.

##Reviewers often ask:

## "How stable is the MMT estimate across model specifications?"

```{r}
mmt_sensitivity <- function(
    data,
    lag_window = 21,
    exposure_dfs = c(3,4,5),
    lag_dfs = c(2,3,4,5)
){

  lag_matrix <- as.matrix(
    data[
      ,
      paste0("utci_lag",0:lag_window)
    ]
  )

  keep <- complete.cases(lag_matrix)

  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix[keep,]

  dat <- data[keep,]

  out <- list()

  k <- 1

  for(vdf in exposure_dfs){

    for(ldf in lag_dfs){

      var_knots <- equalknots(
        dat$utci_mean,
        fun = "ns",
        df = vdf
      )

      lag_knots <- logknots(
        lag_window,
        nk = ldf
      )

      cb <- crossbasis(
        lag_matrix,
        lag = lag_window,
        argvar = list(
          fun = "ns",
          knots = var_knots
        ),
        arglag = list(
          fun = "ns",
          knots = lag_knots
        )
      )

      fit <- gnm(
        outcome ~ cb,
        eliminate = factor(stratum_id),
        family = quasipoisson(),
        data = dat
      )

      pred <- crosspred(
        cb,
        fit,
        by = 0.1
      )

      q <- quantile(
        dat$utci_mean,
        c(.01,.99)
      )

      idx <-
        pred$predvar >= q[1] &
        pred$predvar <= q[2]

      MMT <-
        pred$predvar[idx][
          which.min(
            pred$allRRfit[idx]
          )
        ]

      out[[k]] <- data.frame(
        exposure_df = vdf,
        lag_df = ldf,
        MMT = MMT
      )

      k <- k + 1

    }

  }

  bind_rows(out)

}

```



```{r}
mmt_results <- mmt_sensitivity(
  analysis_ready_matrix,
  lag_window = 21
)
mmt_results

```

```{r}
  )
) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = round(MMT,1)
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Exposure df",
    y = "Lag df",
    fill = "MMT (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Relative Risk Stability at Extreme Temperatures

<!-- This is often more informative than MMT alone. -->

<!-- For example: -->

<!-- Cold effect -->
<!-- 1st percentile vs MMT -->
<!-- Heat effect -->
<!-- 99th percentile vs MMT -->

<!-- Create a table of: -->

<!-- Exposure df	Lag df	RR Cold	RR Heat -->

<!-- and verify whether the estimated risks remain stable across specifications. -->

```{r}
# Extract RR at the 1st and 99th percentile
# 
# For your preferred model:

q <- quantile(
  analysis_ready_matrix$utci_mean,
  c(.01,.99)
)

pred_final <- crosspred(
  cb,
  fit,
  cen = MMT,
  by = 0.1
)

cold_rr <- pred_final$allRRfit[
  which.min(
    abs(pred_final$predvar - q[1])
  )
]

heat_rr <- pred_final$allRRfit[
  which.min(
    abs(pred_final$predvar - q[2])
  )
]

cold_rr
heat_rr
```
